title: ESD loses durable peg relevance and is superseded
description: Empty Set Dollar did not maintain durable dollar stability, while later Empty Set architecture moved beyond the original ESD design.
notes: Exact terminal date is not asserted.

title: Basis Cash fails to sustain its target peg
description: The BAC/BAB/BAS seigniorage system failed to restore durable dollar parity and ceased to function as a relevant stable asset system.
notes: Exact protocol cessation date remains unresolved.

title: Dynamic Set Dollar fails to sustain its target peg
description: DSD and its later design revisions did not restore durable dollar parity or continuing protocol relevance.

title: Cashio Dollar launches on Solana
description: Cashio introduced CASH as a Solana dollar asset collateralized through Saber-related LP positions.

title: Infinite-mint exploit compromises Cashio
description: An attacker bypassed collateral validation and minted unbacked CASH in an infinite-mint exploit.
notes: Published loss estimates vary by methodology.

title: CASH peg collapses after exploit
description: Unlimited unbacked minting caused Cashio Dollar to collapse toward zero and destroyed the protocol's collateral model.

title: Cashio ceases practical operation
description: The exploit and peg collapse ended practical issuance and redemption; later remediation proposals did not restore CASH as a functioning stablecoin.
notes: No restored canonical CASH system is asserted.

title: Acala launches aUSD
description: Acala launched aUSD as a decentralized multi-collateral stablecoin for the Polkadot ecosystem.

title: Erroneous aUSD mint disrupts Acala
description: A configuration error enabled billions of erroneously minted aUSD, disrupting swap ratios and prompting governance intervention.
notes: Official incident report records subsequent tracing and burns.

title: Acala restores aUSD collateralization and operations
description: Governance burns and recovery actions restored full collateralization before Acala resumed operations.
notes: Recovery did not prevent the later aSEED migration.

title: aUSD converts one-to-one into aSEED
description: Acala converted account balances and liquidity positions from aUSD to aSEED one-to-one and updated the on-chain asset registry name and symbol.
notes: Modeled as one continuous asset identity.

title: Basis Cash opens its public protocol and BAC distribution
description: Basis Cash smart contracts opened to users and the original community distribution system for BAC became publicly accessible on November 30, 2020.
notes: The 2020-11-17 official guide is pre-launch context. The public-opening date is kept separate from later exchange listings and the 2021 V2 activation.

title: Basis Cash V2 activates
description: Basis Cash activated its V2 protocol design at 00:00 UTC on April 26, 2021, introducing new liquidity incentives, vault mechanics, and bond and share utilities around the existing BAC system.
notes: V2 is a later protocol-version boundary and does not replace the original 2020-11-30 BAC launch date.
